ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the timeline conflict over the "I'm Here" tap for driver-quality review (no fraud flag).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of waiting more than 3 minutes is contradicted by system records: total time within 200 m before cancellation was 2 min 30 s (F2), arrival-to-cancel 2 min 30 s (F5), stationary 2 min 0 s (F3), and 1 min 40 s in range after the tap (F6). NS-1(iii) therefore fails.

Driver statement of a valid no-show cancellation cannot stand because the >3-minute waiting requirement of NS-1(iii) is not met on the timeline facts; treated as an unsupported statement overridden by system records.
